question: Where’s the closest hotel positioned on the way to Thunder Road Museum, Mt Airy, NC from Basin Cove Overlook, Laurel Springs, NC?
sql: WITH start_point AS ( SELECT geometry::geography AS geom FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Basin Cove Overlook%' LIMIT 1 ), end_point AS ( SELECT geometry::geography AS geom FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Thunder Road Museum%' LIMIT 1 ), path_segment AS ( SELECT ST_MakeLine(s.geom, e.geom) AS geom FROM start_point s, end_point e ), buffered_path AS ( -- Create a 2km buffer around the straight line path to define "on the way" SELECT ST_Buffer(p.geom, 2000) AS geom FROM path_segment p ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city FROM pois p, buffered_path bp, start_point sp WHERE p.tourism = 'hotel' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, bp.geom) ORDER BY ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, sp.geom) ASC LIMIT 1;
